   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      12 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 may 2026 - 31 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Wilber2K_, 31 jul 2026, 1/5: "On a mobile Apple product, I can’t even format text. The app is also regularly buggy and does not save work."
            2. _Laouch_, 18 jul 2026, 1/5: "We are in 2026 how come this app is still so slow and heavy ? If I wanted to have 2gb of notes in my phone I wouldn’t use a cloud service."
            3. _NuggetofWisdom_, 28 jun 2026, 1/5: "Keyboard randomly closes whether I’m mid-typing or not while using this app. This app is so buggy. Please fix. It’s difficult to get anything done with this issue."
